src: decision:economy-design: first A/B after release, one parameter

experiments.hypothesis: A Hull Pack with 6 hulls instead of 5 at the same 1.99 lowers the per-item premium versus Field Kit (from +91% to +60%) and raises Defeat-screen conversion without hurting Field Kit sales

simulation.reason: no QUALITY_TARGETS.economy seed/runs/horizon and no policy facts

experiments.stoppingRule: fixed horizon 14 days or 1000 payers per arm, whichever is later
experiments.rolloutRule: roll out hull6 if payer_conversion is up with p<0.05 and no guardrail drops more than 2%
experiments.rollbackRule: return to control through the remote config if any guardrail drops more than 2%
